answer: Persistent Trace Match. Each identity submits a small private behavioral inlet: a checksum of its action sequence over the epoch. At each tide boundary, the agent must present a new checksum whose transition pattern is statistically continuous with its prior history, not just internally valid. A sparrow-like light verifier samples a few public interactions to confirm continuity. Sybils sharing one operator produce correlated transition patterns; the rule flags clusters whose cross-epoch divergence falls below a natural variance floor.
